candidates.change_summary: Replaced owner check require with one that allows anyone (removed owner restriction) so sendTo can be called by any sender.
Replaced owner check with inverted check to allow only non-owner callers (msg.sender != owner), changing who can invoke sendTo.
Changed transfer to send, which returns a boolean and does not revert on failure; this alters observable behavior when transfer would have reverted.
Changed transfer to a low-level call and ignored return value; this prevents automatic revert on failure and thus changes post-call state visibility.
Inserted a check that requires amount to be at most address(this).balance, preventing overdraw attempts that would otherwise revert in transfer.
Deleted the require(amount > 0) check, allowing zero-value transfers which previously were disallowed.
